definitions.gloss: naturalness; how natural something looks, sounds, or feels
definitions.explanation: The quality or degree of being natural and unforced, describing how authentic or organic something appears, sounds, or feels.

examples.japanese: {自然|しぜん}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自然|しぜん}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧。
⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自然|しぜん}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}した→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I practiced many times to bring out naturalness in my acting.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix さ (degree, -ness) to ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧ (natural). Expresses the quality or degree of being natural — how authentic, unforced, or organic something appears. Frequently used in discussions of language, translation, acting, appearance, and design.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然|しぜん}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have naturalness
- {自然|しぜん}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack naturalness
- {自然|しぜん}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to bring out naturalness
- {自然|しぜん}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain naturalness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ナチュラル→ナチュラル：29886_nachuraru⟧さ: naturalness — loanword version; often used in beauty and fashion contexts
- {自然体|しぜんたい}: natural posture/attitude — being oneself without pretense
- ⟦{不自然|ふしぜん}さ→不自然さ：24714_fushizensa⟧: unnaturalness — the opposite quality
